attributes.action: Make It Harder For Kids To Be Banned From Football. FA Powers Only Not Clubs.
attributes.additional_details: Too many instances happen where kids are blamed for being violent by singing and celebrating, just trying to make an atmosphere at non league games no matter the level. From local teams all the way to the EFL. Somethings have to change. Adults close to clubs often blame kids and act in an inappropriate manner going into their social media’s to send kids faces to people who may not be DBS checked and try get them banned for football because they don’t like the kids being around despite the money.
attributes.background: Some people just seem to have a problem with a group of kids going home and away following teams in big groups and funding money into non league. To stop adults trying to blame them for everything meaning clubs ban easier. I believe banning orders have to have evidence and all be done by the FA Only
